actions.text: Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Hearings held.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects patients and administrators at combined Department of Defense and Department of Veterans Affairs federal medical facilities.
dimensions.evidence: designated combined Federal medical facilities of the Department of Defense and the Department of Veterans Affairs

dimensions.assessment: Streamlines administrative, funding, and financial reconciliation processes for shared military and veteran healthcare facilities.
dimensions.evidence: The purpose of the Fund shall be to facilitate the joint funding of designated combined Federal medical facilities

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes ongoing interagency transfers of funds and collections for facility operations, capital equipment, maintenance, and minor construction.
dimensions.evidence: Amounts may be transferred to the Fund by the Secretary of Defense... and by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 10 of the United States Code and repeals prior authorization language while establishing formal executive agreements and reporting.
dimensions.evidence: Chapter 55 of title 10, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Codifies permanent statutory authority for the joint fund and its administrative framework.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 10, United States Code, to codify authority for the Joint Medical Facility Fund

missing_information: The specific dollar amounts to be transferred between the departments are not stated in the text.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill codifies authority for the Joint Medical Facility Fund between the Department of Defense and the Department of Veterans Affairs, establishing permanent administrative and financial transfer mechanisms.
